backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor handling stories, comments, reviews, user profiles, and access control with persistent maps and submission/query methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the role and functionality of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister usage, differences between frontend and backend canisters, and deployment steps for the app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode values, and base layout styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point containing the root div and script loader for the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration defining all frontend routes including home, stories, submit, admin, discussions, and contact pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component displaying an access denied message with guidance and navigation back to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation header with brand title and buttons for Home, About, and Contact routing.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared page layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with contact and navigation links.
Form component allowing users to submit comments with handle and text fields, integrated with comment mutation logic.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays comments for a story using useGetComments, showing loading skeletons, empty state, and formatted timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows comments for a story from all discussions, handling loading, empty state, and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Renders canister diagnostics with copy-to-clipboard actions for troubleshooting deployment issues.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Provides a form to submit a review with name, rating, and optional comment using useAddReview.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays all reviews for a story with ratings, timestamps, and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on user identity, reinitializing queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all stories and publish stories via admin functions using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend heartbeat to determine availability, exposing reachability state and errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Fetches all discussions and provides a mutation to add reviews, invalidating relevant queries on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login state and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: React Query hooks for fetching published stories, individual stories, comments, and submitting stories or comments via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark pastel-blue themes, global styles, typography, and accessibility states.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page describing the author and providing contact details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface to review, edit, and publish submitted stories, with error handling and authorization checks.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page presenting the author's details, book info, email link, and social media profiles.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays all discussion topics and lets users switch between comment and review threads for a selected story.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Loads and displays published stories with error handling, backend availability checks, and a retry workflow.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero content, navigation buttons, and feature highlights for reading and sharing stories.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Shows a full story with metadata and includes a comments section with composer and thread display.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Form for submitting a new story with anonymous options and post-submit confirmation UI.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Provides guidance on canister ID resolution issues and displays environment-derived canister details with copy helpers.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Provides functions to detect frontend and backend canister IDs from hostname or environment and generate corresponding access URLs, including legacy helpers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Offers helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage hash-based parameter cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, known issues, and feature requests related to implementing and fixing a Contact page.
